title: Rewrite mart_profitability_trends for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers
body:
## Parent

Part of #1 (Spec: Rewrite Downstream Marts for the Unpivoted fct_compute_offers)

## What to build

Rewrite `mart_profitability_trends` to operate on the unpivoted `fct_compute_offers` fact table. Keep the tariff window schedule join, but to the renamed `dim_electricity_tariff_window_schedule` dimension, joining on day_of_week/hour/valid_from/valid_to. Alias the scheduled window as `scheduled_tariff_window` to avoid collision with the fact's own `tariff_window_type`. Group by hour + GPU attributes + scheduled window + tier context (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`). Aggregate `profit_usd_per_hr` and `profit_per_tflop_usd` (avg/min/max) plus `avg_revenue_usd_per_hr` and `offer_count`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mart joins to `dim_electricity_tariff_window_schedule` on day_of_week/hour/valid_from/valid_to
- [ ] The scheduled window is aliased as `scheduled_tariff_window`, distinct from the fact's `tariff_window_type`
- [ ] The mart groups by hour + GPU attributes + `scheduled_tariff_window` + tier context (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`)
- [ ] The mart aggregates `profit_usd_per_hr` and `profit_per_tflop_usd` (avg/min/max) plus `avg_revenue_usd_per_hr` and `offer_count`

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
